question: The diagonal of a rectangle is sqrt{89} cm and its area is 40 { cm}² . Find the perimeter of the rectangle.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let sides = a, b

a² + b² = 89 and ab = 40

(a + b)² = 89 + 2×40 = 169

a + b = 13

Perimeter = 2(a + b) = 26

**∴ Answer = 26 cm**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diagonal = √89 cm

Area = 40 cm²

**Formula used:**

Diagonal² = a² + b², Area = ab

**Calculation:**

⇒ a² + b² = 89

⇒ ab = 40

⇒ (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

⇒ = 89 + 80 = 169

⇒ a + b = 13

⇒ Perimeter = 2(a + b) = 26 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 26 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Key Identity

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

Rectangle Property

Diagonal² = sum of squares of sides

Quick Trick

Find (a + b) first, then multiply by 2
